vscode.view.release.name: Release Preview
vscode.walkthrough.description: Run the tasks of your workspace, see what the changes affect and keep it healthy.
vscode.walkthrough.monosmith-start-affec:
Run one task in the projects the changes affect: the rest is not touched, and what did not change comes from the cache.
[Run affected](command:monosmith.runAffected)
vscode.walkthrough.monosmith-start-healt:
The Health view lists the checks that failed with the remedy, and applies the fixes smith proposes after you have seen them. Dependencies and Release Preview are beside it.
[Open the Health view](command:monosmith.health.focus)
Check the health of the workspace
vscode.walkthrough.monosmith-start-proje:
The MonoSmith view lists the apps, libs and packages of the workspace, with their tasks. A dot marks a project the changes affect.
[Open the MonoSmith view](command:workbench.view.extension.monosmith)
vscode.walkthrough.monosmith-start-run.d:
Press Enter on a task, or pick one from the palette. The output streams as it happens, and what failed lands in the Problems panel.
[Run a task](command:monosmith.runTask)
vscode.walkthrough.monosmith-start-smith:
MonoSmith runs the smith your team installed, so the editor, the terminal and CI agree. Install it in the workspace or put it on the PATH.
[Copy the install command](command:monosmith.copyInstallCommand)
[Choose another smith](command:monosmith.openSettings)
vscode.walkthrough.monosmith-start-tasks:
Tasks of type "smith" appear in Run Task and in tasks.json. Ctrl+Alt+M then T, A, R or C runs, runs affected, re-runs and cancels.
[Open the settings](command:monosmith.openSettings)
Use it from tasks.json and the keyboard

vscode.welcome.smith-could-not-start-or-:
smith could not start, or it stopped.
[Restart smith](command:monosmith.restart)
See the [log](command:monosmith.showOutput), or check the [settings](command:monosmith.openSettings).
vscode.welcome.smith-was-not-found-monos:
smith was not found.
MonoSmith runs the smith your team installed, so the editor, the terminal and CI agree. Install it in the workspace, put it on the PATH, or set monosmith.path.
[Copy install command](command:monosmith.copyInstallCommand)
[Open settings](command:monosmith.openSettings)
[Retry](command:monosmith.refresh)
[Show log](command:monosmith.showOutput)
vscode.welcome.this-folder-is-empty-mono:
This folder is empty.
MonoSmith can start a workspace here. It asks how you want to set it up (the defaults, or customise), shows what smith will create, and writes nothing until you say yes.
[Create a new MonoSmith workspace](command:monosmith.new)
[Learn more](https://github.com/monosmith-app/monosmith)
vscode.welcome.this-folder-is-not-a-mono:
This folder is not a MonoSmith workspace yet.
smith found no monorepo tool here. It can still bring the folder in: it lists every change and asks before it makes any, and your files stay where they are.
[Bring this folder into MonoSmith](command:monosmith.adopt.start)
You can [see what would change](command:monosmith.adopt.preview) first, or [learn more](https://github.com/monosmith-app/monosmith).
vscode.welcome.this-looks-like-a-reposit:
This looks like a repository with several projects.
smith lists every change and asks before it makes any. Your projects stay where they are.
[Convert it to MonoSmith](command:monosmith.adopt.start)
You can [see what would change](command:monosmith.adopt.preview) first, or [learn more](https://github.com/monosmith-app/monosmith).
vscode.welcome.this-looks-like-a-turbore:
This looks like a Turborepo workspace.
smith lists every change and asks before it makes any. Your projects stay where they are.
[Convert it to MonoSmith](command:monosmith.adopt.start)
You can [see what would change](command:monosmith.adopt.preview) first, or [learn more](https://github.com/monosmith-app/monosmith).
vscode.welcome.this-looks-like-an-nx-wor:

[Convert it to MonoSmith](command:monosmith.adopt.start)
You can [see what would change](command:monosmith.adopt.preview) first, or [learn more](https://github.com/monosmith-app/monosmith).
vscode.welcome.this-workspace-has-no-pro:
This workspace has no projects yet.
[Add your first project](command:monosmith.addProject)
smith asks what you are building, shows the plan, and writes nothing until you say yes.
vscode.welcome.this-workspace-is-not-tru:
This workspace is not trusted.
MonoSmith does not run the smith inside an untrusted workspace (node_modules/.bin, .smith/bin), and it does not run tasks there. Trust the workspace, or use a smith from the monosmith.path user setting or the PATH.
[Manage Workspace Trust](command:workbench.trust.manage)
[Open settings](command:monosmith.openSettings)
[Retry](command:monosmith.refresh)
